title: Brain implants link experiencers to the gray hive mind

tellings.quote: It turns you into a walking bug and it and it connects you to the gray hive of mind. They told me that too.

plain: A man named Steve Coburn, who says he has had contact with alien beings, spoke on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels in an episode about implants said to be found in human bodies. Coburn says such an implant "turns you into a walking bug" and links the person to a shared group mind of the grays, the gray-skinned beings often described in abduction stories. He says the beings told him this themselves, which would mean the people who carry these implants are not fully in control of their own minds.
